title: The Ties That Bind: Computational, Cross-cultural Analyses of Knots Reveal Their Cultural Evolutionary History and Significance
lineage: Independent topological analysis using archaeological knot descriptions and illustrations, including Pälsi's Antrea evidence. This is a new interpretation of published knot data, not new excavation or direct dating.

passages.locator: pp. 479–481, Discussion: Cultural transmission, task differentiation, and the deep past of knots; Fig. 1E
passages.note: Classifies the published Antrea knot as a sheet bend in an alternative orientation and compares similarly classified knots at Zamostje-2, Vis-1 and Satrup. The authors leave open transmission versus convergence. Their reported Antrea age of 10,522 cal BP cites Manninen et al., rather than a new radiocarbon test.
